title: GitHub Actions automation workflows: job GITHUB_TOKEN is contents: read; PR and write scopes come from the mlflow-app App token
answers: Why does the uv.lock update workflow no longer have pull-requests write permission on GITHUB_TOKEN?
A workflow that opens or edits PRs fails with 403 after a permissions change; where do PR write scopes come from now?
Where is the permissions block for the experimental decorator removal or model catalog bot jobs?
How do I give a new scheduled bot job write access to create PRs without widening GITHUB_TOKEN?
body:
Path: `.github/workflows/uv.yml` (uv.lock auto-update job), `.github/workflows/remove-experimental-decorators.yml` (decorator-removal job), and `.github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml` (catalog PR job) are scheduled or manual bot jobs that push branches and open PRs; their job-level `permissions:` block is the chokepoint.
Rule: Keep each of these jobs at `permissions: contents: read` at job level. Do not re-add `contents: write` or `pull-requests: write` to the job's GITHUB_TOKEN. Write operations that need to reach GitHub go through the `mlflow-app` token minted by `actions/create-github-app-token` in the job's first step, and that token's scopes are what preserve write access.
Constraints: Applies to the job-level GITHUB_TOKEN of these bot workflows. Does not cover `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` used by a separate publish job in update-model-catalog.yml, which keeps its own permissions. Verify that any new write step uses the App token output (`steps.app-token.outputs.token`) rather than `github.token`, or it will fail under read-only permissions.
applies: Workflow permission blocks in .github/workflows for scheduled or manual bot jobs that open PRs or push branches using the mlflow-app GitHub App.
says: Scheduled dependency update bot fails with permission denied when opening a pull request.
Automated maintenance tasks cannot push branches or create pull requests on the repository.
Enable automated catalog update tasks to submit pull requests using repository app credentials.
Automated code cleanup bot receives authorization errors when submitting pull requests.
search: GitHub Actions automation workflows in .github/workflows/uv.yml, .github/workflows/remove-experimental-decorators.yml, and .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml restrict job-level GITHUB_TOKEN to contents: read. Pull request creation and branch pushes must use the token minted by actions/create-github-app-token via steps.app-token.outputs.token rather than github.token. This policy applies to these automated bot jobs and excludes the separate publish job in update-model-catalog.yml which uses secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN.
